title: Grid boolean cells: the read-only checkbox the boolean cell renderer draws has no accessible name, so a screen reader announces "checkbox, not checked" with no field
body:
Filing gate: ① — a user-visible accessibility defect with a named location, measured in the browser's own tree.

## Symptom (measured by the cloud session of objectstack-ai/objectui#12510, on objectui `572bbce`, HotCRM `63db83e`)

Studio Data pillar › HotCRM › Account › Records tab. The browser's computed tree (CDP `Accessibility.getFullAXTree`) lists 9 `checkbox` nodes with an empty name: one per row of the `is_active` column. The runtime list page draws its cells with the same renderer (decision D of objectstack-ai/objectui#12446), so it reads the same.

reach: the Studio Records grid and the runtime list grid (UI doors). Measured on the Studio door only.

## Cause

`packages/fields/src/index.tsx` on objectui `f96f771`, the boolean cell renderer, line 1014:

```
<Checkbox checked={value} disabled className="pointer-events-none" />
```

There is no `aria-label`, no `aria-labelledby`, and no text beside it. The renderer's two other outcomes already name themselves:
- The completion indicator (`completed`, `is_done`, …) carries `role="img"` and `aria-label` from `fields.boolean.completed` / `fields.boolean.notCompleted`.
- The off badge for status fields reads `fields.boolean.offBadge` with the field's label, `field?.label || humanizeLabel(fieldName)`.

## Fix

Name the checkbox by the field, as the off badge already does: `aria-label={field?.label || humanizeLabel(fieldName)}`. Its checked state is announced by the role, so the name carries no state word. There is no visual change, and no new i18n key is needed.

## Acceptance

1. A unit test renders the boolean cell renderer for a field with a label and asserts `getByRole('checkbox', { name: <label> })`, both checked and unchecked.
2. A field with no label falls back to the humanized name.
3. CONTROL: the completion indicator and the off badge keep their current names.

## Who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The fix reader is the `domain:ui` lane that owns `packages/fields`. It came out of objectstack-ai/objectui#12510, which named only buttons, links and comboboxes, and it is not part of epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446.

## Dedupe (2026-10-15, MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed)

- "boolean cell checkbox accessible name aria-label grid read-only checkbox unnamed screen reader": 4 hits, none this defect: objectui#11924, objectui#11051, objectui#10435 (closed a11y findings, so the channel was live) and objectui#8490 (the empty-array value of the same renderer, closed).

Filed by seat `domain:ui#4` (session `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`) from the out-of-scope finding of the objectstack-ai/objectui#12510 report.
